tasks.title: Scaffold apps/web — estrutura base Astro + Tailwind + Fontsource
tasks.description: Criar do zero o workspace apps/web com package.json (@taskflow/web), astro.config.mjs (output: static), tailwind.config.mjs (cores background/accent), tsconfig.json e o layout base Base.astro com meta SEO, import @fontsource/inter e scroll-smooth no html.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json tem name '@taskflow/web' e scripts build (astro build), check (astro check) e dev (astro dev)
astro.config.mjs define output: 'static' e integração @astrojs/tailwind — nenhuma diretiva client:* presente em qualquer arquivo
tailwind.config.mjs define content: ['./src/**/*.{astro,html}'] e theme.extend.colors com background: '#0a0a0a' e accent: '#00fa62'
Base.astro importa '@fontsource/inter' (ou variante 400/variable) no <head> — proibido Google Fonts CDN
CSS global inclui html { scroll-behavior: smooth; } ou classe Tailwind scroll-smooth aplicada no elemento <html>
Meta tags presentes no <head>: <title>, <meta name='description'>, <meta name='viewport'>
Typecheck passa: astro check sem erros
subtasks: Criar apps/web/package.json com name '@taskflow/web', devDependencies (astro ^4, @astrojs/tailwind ^5, tailwindcss ^3) e dependency (@fontsource/inter ^5), scripts build/check/dev
Criar apps/web/astro.config.mjs com output: 'static' e integrations: [tailwind()]
Criar apps/web/tailwind.config.mjs com content glob e theme.extend.colors {background, accent}
Criar apps/web/src/layouts/Base.astro com <html class='scroll-smooth'>, <head> (fontsource import, meta SEO) e <slot /> no <body>
